title: Nether Calculator
description: This plugin makes converting coordinates between the Nether and Overworld dimensions easy
body:
# NetherCalculator Plugin Usage Guide

This plugin makes converting coordinates between the Nether and Overworld dimensions easy:

# Commands:
### Convert Nether to Overworld:
**/nether_to_overworld <x> <z> [y]**
![nether to overworld pic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b07c7141ec90131651956b0f95c544d712c8791_0.webp)
Enter your Nether coordinates and see the equivalent Overworld location.


### Convert Overworld to Nether:
**/overworld_to_nether <x> <z> [y]**
![overworld to nether pic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2abb6dc7039e403085273d7eec52c431b4d06c6a_0.webp)
Enter your Overworld coordinates and see the equivalent Nether location.


# Notes:
The Y coordinate is optional for both commands.
Tab completion will guide you through entering coordinates.
The plugin handles the 1:8 ratio conversion automatically.
Results are displayed with both original and converted coordinates.
Perfect for planning Nether portals and efficient travel between dimensions!
